listing.name: Dino Crisis — Dino-Crisis-Modern-Edition (Rotmill)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream native DinoCrisis mod/development feature claims, not Portcove completion. Supported-disc installer route is distinct from proving every enhancement/gameplay path. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own DinoCrisis PS1 Track1 BIN/CUE: USA SLUS00922v1.0/v1.1; supported PAL SLES02207–02211 require corresponding SBI; Japanese SLPS02180 and named RussianUSA translation also listed. No sibling RE source inherited.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Manual DinoCrisisME_Setup.exe or unpacked setup tools select owned supported disc and locally generate C/compile native game+mod with bundled compiler/Python/PSXRecomp; no precompiled game download asserted.
